note: The obituary "Send flowers" fallback: a Florist One affiliate link, used only when the obituary's funeral home has no known florist page (data/funeral-homes.json). affiliateId is empty until Sam joins the program; with no ID the link is hidden. The server env var FLORIST_ONE_AFFILIATE_ID, when set, wins over affiliateId. affiliateUrl is the link with {id} replaced by the ID. Its shape is the one Florist One's own published affiliate links use (https://www.floristone.com/index.cfm?AffiliateID=<id>&source_id=aff); the signup page doesn't show it before joining.
